d: Grand Theft Auto 6 may become one of gaming's biggest releases, but its developers are facing growing concerns over job security. Rockstar employees are working amid widespread layoffs across the gaming industry, pressure to unionise and uncertainty over how AI could reshape their jobs. At Rockstar North, workers are voting on union recognition, while the company faces an employment tribunal over the dismissal of 34 employees. Despite the massive expectations surrounding GTA 6, developers say a blockbuster game's success does not guarantee secure jobs.
